summary.text: Tiara Auxier is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 4 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gov. Spencer Cox appointed her to the seat in January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Tiara Auxier worked as a tax accountant in Salt Lake City before her appointment to the Utah House of Representatives.
She has also served on district and school community councils in Salt Lake and Morgan counties.
Ballotpedia reports that Gov. Spencer Cox appointed her to District 4 on January 21, 2025, to replace Kera Birkeland.
